text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today, Mejiro Dober is training in her<n>signature
racewear to get a feel for<n>what it'll be like in a real
race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Could I take a break? I can't seem to<n>run well...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Her eyes aren't on me as she says<n>that. Instead...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That racewear... She must be a<n>Mejiro. It looks like
her game's off<n>today.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was just her first lap. Let's<n>see how
things go.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She seems bothered by the presence<n>of other
trainers watching her run.
choice_data_list: Want to call off training for today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: All I said is that I wanted to take a<n>break!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: We don't have to go that far... It's<n>just, I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I hate this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to stress her out more,<n>but my
suggestion ends up doing<n>just that...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to stress her out more,<n>but my
suggestion ends up doing<n>just that...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, I wonder if her<n>previous trainer
would have been<n>able to sympathize with her
more...
choice_data_list: (No, this isn't the time for that!)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I chase after Mejiro Dober and<n>search all over the
academy before<n>finally finding her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I told you I was fine.
What are you apologizing for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...It's okay. You don't need to<n>apologize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The colors of this racewear are the<n>traditional colors
of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I settled on this design because I<n>want to be able to
run like the others<n>too... like a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But... when I think of people seeing<n>me run as a
member of the Mejiro<n>family...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can't run with the same dominance<n>and elegance
that McQueen shows...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nor can I meet people's expectations<n>as
confidently and cheerfully as<n>Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They're leaps and bounds ahead of<n>me, and so
long as I'm wearing this,<n>I'll always be compared
to them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried that my running will bring<n>shame to the
Mejiro name...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
How could you? Don't just say<n>whatever to try
and console me!
choice_data_list: I know what it's like to have big shoes to fill.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?
choice_data_list: I know what it's like to have big shoes to fill.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I see... You're struggling with the<n>same thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And yet, you aren't backing down<n>from it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Then I won't either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...And how could I, after seeing how<n>hard you
work?

Nothing good will come from running<n>away.
Besides, it would be irritating if<n>I lost to you.
choice_data_list: There's no need to pressure yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I won't give up. We can do<n>this, together.
choice_data_list: There's no need to pressure yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Cut it out with that chipper attitude!<n>Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You don't have to shout... I-it's<n>embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why, Dober, it's you! I couldn't help<n>but come over
when I saw the<n>Mejiro colors.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why, Dober, it's you! I couldn't help<n>but come over
when I saw the<n>Mejiro colors.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What kind of training are you doing<n>today?
Something tells me this is no<n>ordinary session.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, I'm trying to replicate what a<n>real race will
feel like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that would explain the racewear,<n>and why
something felt different<n>about you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To don those colors is to shoulder the<n>Mejiro
name. May I have the<n>pleasure of testing your
readiness for<n>such a responsibility?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You mean you want to race me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Only if you would allow it.
...Okay. I'll show you that I'm ready.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of them have a spectacular<n>run, and
training goes well after that.<n>The sight of them gets
spectators<n>cheering from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I have to try...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I have to try...
...Anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's true... But where?

...Lifting weights in racewear doesn't<n>exactly feel
like an action befitting the<n>Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Lifting weights in racewear doesn't<n>exactly feel
like an action befitting the<n>Mejiro name.
Lifting in racewear? I love it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for coming in out of nowhere. I<n>was doing
some bench presses<n>when I heard your voice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm serious about what I just said,<n>by the way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No matter where you do it, just trying<n>your best to
get stronger is what the<n>Mejiro name's all about!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Um... Th-thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're welcome! All right! Time<n>for me to get
back to it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Ryan. And...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I suppose I'm grateful for you too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you for always cheering me<n>on, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober gets in a good workout<n>while
wearing her signature<n>racewear.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober gets in a good workout<n>while
wearing her signature<n>racewear.
